templates.github_actions:
- uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Run Playwright E2E tests
        run: npx playwright test --reporter=html,junit
        env:
          BASE_URL: ${{ vars.E2E_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000' }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 14
templates.gitlab_ci:
image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.48.0-jammy
  variables:
    BASE_URL: ${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
  script:
    - npm ci
    - npx playwright test --reporter=html,junit
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - playwright-report/
      - test-results/
    expire_in: 14 days
templates.azure_devops:
- script: |
              npm ci
              npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
            displayName: Install Playwright
          - script: |
              npx playwright test --reporter=html,junit
            displayName: Run Playwright E2E tests
            env:
              BASE_URL: $(E2E_BASE_URL)
          - task: PublishBuildArtifacts@1
            condition: always()
            inputs:
              PathtoPublish: 'playwright-report/'
              ArtifactName: 'playwright-report'
templates.jenkins:
sh '''
                        npm ci
                        npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
                        BASE_URL=${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3000} npx playwright test --reporter=html,junit
                    '''
                    archiveArtifacts artifacts: 'playwright-report/**, test-results/**', allowEmptyArchive: true
templates.circleci:
npm ci

            BASE_URL=${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3000} npx playwright test --reporter=html,junit
templates.bitbucket:

            - npx playwright install chromium
            - BASE_URL=${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3000} npx playwright test --reporter=html,junit
            artifacts:
              - playwright-report/**
              - test-results/**

templates.github_actions:
- name: Run Snyk dependency scan
        uses: snyk/actions/node@master
        continue-on-error: ${{ vars.SNYK_FAIL_ON_ISSUES == 'false' }}
        env:
          SNYK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SNYK_TOKEN }}
        with:
          args: --severity-threshold=${{ vars.SNYK_SEVERITY_THRESHOLD || 'high' }}
      - name: Upload Snyk report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: snyk-report
          path: snyk.sarif
          if-no-files-found: ignore
templates.gitlab_ci:
image: node:20-bullseye
  before_script:
    - npm install -g snyk
  script:
    - snyk auth $SNYK_TOKEN
    - snyk test --severity-threshold=${SNYK_SEVERITY_THRESHOLD:-high} --sarif-file-output=snyk.sarif || ${SNYK_FAIL_ON_ISSUES:-true}
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - snyk.sarif
templates.azure_devops:
- task: SnykSecurityScan@1
            inputs:
              serviceConnectionEndpoint: 'Snyk Service Connection'
              testType: 'app'
              severityThreshold: '$(SNYK_SEVERITY_THRESHOLD)'
              failOnIssues: '$(SNYK_FAIL_ON_ISSUES)'
            displayName: Snyk Dependency Scan

- npm install -g snyk
            - snyk auth $SNYK_TOKEN
            - snyk test --severity-threshold=${SNYK_SEVERITY_THRESHOLD:-high} --sarif-file-output=snyk.sarif || ${SNYK_FAIL_ON_ISSUES:-true}
            artifacts:
              - snyk.sarif

templates.github_actions:
- name: Run npm audit
        run: |
          npm audit --audit-level=${{ vars.AUDIT_LEVEL || 'high' }} --json > npm-audit-report.json || true
          VULN_COUNT=$(jq '.metadata.vulnerabilities.high + .metadata.vulnerabilities.critical' npm-audit-report.json 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "High/Critical vulnerabilities found: $VULN_COUNT"
          if [ "$VULN_COUNT" -gt 0 ] && [ "${{ vars.AUDIT_FAIL_ON_HIGH || 'true' }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "::error::Found $VULN_COUNT high/critical vulnerabilities"
            exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: npm-audit-report
          path: npm-audit-report.json

templates.github_actions:
- name: Configure AWS Credentials via OIDC
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION || 'us-east-1' }}
      - name: Package Lambda function
        run: |
          zip -r function.zip . -x '*.git*' 'node_modules/.cache/*'
      - name: Deploy to AWS Lambda
        run: |
          aws lambda update-function-code \
            --function-name ${{ secrets.LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME }} \
            --zip-file fileb://function.zip \
            --region ${{ vars.AWS_REGION || 'us-east-1' }}
          aws lambda wait function-updated \
            --function-name ${{ secrets.LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME }} \
            --region ${{ vars.AWS_REGION || 'us-east-1' }}
      - name: Verify Lambda deployment
        run: |
          aws lambda invoke --function-name ${{ secrets.LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME }} --payload '{}' /tmp/response.json --region ${{ vars.AWS_REGION || 'us-east-1' }}
          cat /tmp/response.json

        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION || 'us-east-1' }}
      - name: Sync build output to S3
        run: |
          aws s3 sync ${{ vars.STATIC_BUILD_DIR || './dist' }} s3://${{ secrets.S3_BUCKET_NAME }} --delete --cache-control max-age=31536000,public
          aws s3 cp s3://${{ secrets.S3_BUCKET_NAME }}/index.html s3://${{ secrets.S3_BUCKET_NAME }}/index.html --metadata-directive REPLACE --cache-control max-age=0,no-cache,no-store,must-revalidate
      - name: Invalidate CloudFront cache
        run: |
          DISTRIBUTION_ID=${{ secrets.CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID }}
          INVALIDATION_ID=$(aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $DISTRIBUTION_ID --paths '/*' --query 'Invalidation.Id' --output text)
          echo "Invalidation created: $INVALIDATION_ID"
          aws cloudfront wait invalidation-completed --distribution-id $DISTRIBUTION_ID --id $INVALIDATION_ID
      - name: Verify static site
        run: |
          curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://${{ secrets.CLOUDFRONT_DOMAIN }}" || echo 'Verification failed'

components.notes: Inserted between test and deploy stages for production releases. GitHub/Azure/GitLab support this natively via environment protection rules; Jenkins/CircleCI/Bitbucket require an explicit input/hold step.

templates.github_actions:
deploy:
    name: Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment:
      name: ${{ vars.APPROVAL_ENVIRONMENT || 'production' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # NOTE: configure required reviewers on the 'production' environment
      # under Settings > Environments so this job pauses for manual approval.
templates.gitlab_ci:
deploy:
  stage: deploy
  only:
    - main
  when: manual
  environment:
    name: ${APPROVAL_ENVIRONMENT:-production}
  script:
    - echo 'Manual approval required to proceed with deploy.'
templates.azure_devops:
- stage: Deploy
    displayName: Deploy Stage
    dependsOn: Test
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployJob
        displayName: Deploy
        environment: '$(APPROVAL_ENVIRONMENT)'
        # NOTE: configure approvals and checks on the Azure DevOps Environment
        # resource so this stage pauses for manual approval.
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - checkout: self
templates.jenkins: input message: 'Approve deployment to production?', ok: 'Deploy'
templates.circleci:
hold_for_approval:
    type: approval

workflows:
  main:
    jobs:
      - pipeline_run
      - hold_for_approval:
          requires:
            - pipeline_run
      - deploy_job:
          requires:
            - hold_for_approval
templates.bitbucket:
- step:
          name: Manual approval
          trigger: manual
          script:
            - echo 'Manual approval required to proceed with deploy.'

known_bug_fixes_applied: Rollback trigger should use 'needs.deploy.result == failure' rather than bare 'if: failure()', to avoid triggering rollback when an unrelated job (e.g. alert) fails instead of deploy.

SSH-based health checks referencing ${APP_PORT:-8080} inside a remote SSH command must have APP_PORT explicitly exported/passed into the SSH session — it is not inherited from the CI runner's environment.
azure_devops skeleton template previously had duplicate PIP_CACHE_DIR / npm_config_cache variable definitions — removed in this dataset's usage guidance.
job.status in alerting templates refers to the current (alert) job, not the upstream deploy job — use needs.deploy.result instead.

7. cloud_auth (only if deployment_target.auth_type == oidc or workload_identity)
